answer: Draw five jurors and compare their scores. Slash every juror more than one point off the median, and pay the ones who agreed. Reset the quorum history the moment two accounts share a device or a funding path. Let idle agents bleed standing while the panel is redrawn. One quartz of disagreement cracks the batch, a single onyx mark of shared funding resets 1,000 keys, and rebuilding that basalt takes six epochs.
